messages:
deploybot: Deploy started for tag v3.2.1-candidate (commit ab12c3d) -> staging. Pipeline: build/test/lint. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/98765 :rocket:
jess-prodops: Heads-up, change window open until 18:00 PT. Keep an eye on infra quota.
alex-release: Which commit contains the dependency bump?
sam-eng: That's the one: added `libtextproc@2.0.0` in package.json, might trigger new lint rules.
miguel-qa: Kicking off sanity tests once build passes. ping me when lint done.
ci-bot: Build step complete ✅
ci-bot: Test step complete ✅
ci-bot: Lint step FAILED ❌
ci-bot: Lint output:
```
src/tokenizer/tokenize.rs:45: warning: unused variable `tmp`
src/ui/render.rs:12: error: trailing-whitespace detected
src/cli/args.rs:3: error: new-lint-rule 'no-hard-tabs' violated
```
sam-eng: Ugh, the new lint rules are strict and this bump pulled in different formatting. Might be noisy.
linda-sre: Any flakiness known on CI env? OS image mismatch? :eyes:
sam-eng: Not on build infra. This is deterministic code style errors.
jess-prodops: Options: 1) fix lint in candidate, 2) pin libtextproc to 1.x for this rollout, 3) hold release and merge hotfix after fixes.
miguel-qa: Prefer hold + tiny fixes if it's just whitespace. But we need a quick decision for the change window.
alex-release: Can we auto-fix whitespace and re-run lint quickly?
sam-eng: Auto-fix handles trailing whitespace and tabs, but tests need to be rerun — about ~12m pipeline time.
jess-prodops: Given change window, I'd rather pin and iterate. Pin is fastest to keep momentum.
linda-sre: Pinning is safe if we record in release notes and schedule follow-up to unpin. Ensure security scan unaffected.
alex-release: I'll open a hotfix branch `hotfix/pin-libtextproc-1.x` and push change now.
ci-bot: New commit pushed by alex-release: 9f8e7d4 -> pipeline triggered: https://ci.internal/runs/98766
miguel-qa: Re-running sanity once pipeline green.
ci-bot: Build ✅ Test ✅ Lint ✅ (pin applied)
deploybot: Deploy to staging finished for tag v3.2.1-candidate (commit 9f8e7d4). Duration: 24m.
jess-prodops: Thanks team — holding production rollout until we confirm no regressions and add unpin ticket to sprint. :thumbsup:
sam-eng: Created issue RED-2456 to track unpin + proper lint compatibility.
miguel-qa: Quick smoke looks good, will run extended tests at 11:30.
linda-sre: Noted in change log and security scan passed on pinned version.
alex-release: Release notes draft updated with the pin and follow-up plan.
jess-prodops: Closing thread, leaving rollout window open until final sign-off. If anything else pops up, call it out here. :eyes:
